caption: Warm, curious, gently uplifting documentary underscore for a short history explainer, 92 BPM, major key. Soft pizzicato strings, warm felt piano, light wooden marimba, soft upright bass, gentle brushed shaker, airy warm string pad. Sunlit, earnest and tactile, a little whimsical, like a story about an inventor in a workshop and workers building a great bridge at golden hour. Steady pulse that sits under a spoken narrator, swells gently near the end and resolves on a warm major chord. Soft rounded high end, never harsh, never bright, no heavy drums, no cymbal crashes.
lyrics:
[Intro - soft pizzicato and felt piano]

[Verse - marimba joins, upright bass, brushed shaker]

[Verse - warm string pad, gentle build]

[Chorus - fuller strings, hopeful, still soft]

[Outro - resolves on a warm held chord]
